definitions.explanation: A person who gives live running commentary — especially someone who streams video games while narrating. {実況|じっきょう} (live commentary) + {者|しゃ} (person).

examples.japanese: {人気|にんき}の{実況者|じっきょうしゃ}を{見|み}る。
ゲーム{実況者|じっきょうしゃ}になりたい。
examples.english: I want to become a game streamer.

examples.japanese: その{実況者|じっきょうしゃ}は{話|はな}し{方|かた}が{面白|おもしろ}くて{人気|にんき}がある。
examples.english: That commentator is popular because of their entertaining way of talking.

notes:
{実況|じっきょう} (live commentary, play-by-play) + {者|しゃ} (person). Most often refers to game streamers on platforms like YouTube, though it can also mean a sports or event commentator.

RELATED WORDS:
- {実況|じっきょう}: live commentary
- ゲーム{実況|じっきょう}: game-play streaming with commentary
- {配信者|はいしんしゃ}: streamer, broadcaster (general)
